name: auth-better-auth
description: Authentication with Better Auth — email/password + OAuth providers, session management, and protected routes

envVars.name: AUTH_SECRET
envVars.description: Secret key for signing session tokens (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32)

ai.whenToUse: Use when the project needs user authentication — login, signup, session management, and protected routes. Better Auth supports email/password and OAuth providers (GitHub, Google, etc.).
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for public-only sites with no user accounts, or projects that need a different auth provider (e.g. Clerk, Auth0). Not suitable for static-only deployments.
